about.title: We launched today! 🎉
about.subtitle: TechRadar.uz is the open stage of Uzbekistan's tech ecosystem. Today is day one. Everything you see is being built by the community right now.
about.manifesto1: We believe world-class products are born in Uzbekistan — startups, AI services, Telegram bots and Mini Apps. They need a stage where first users, investors and future teammates can see them.
about.manifesto2: TechRadar.uz is that stage. Founders launch in public here, collect honest feedback and community votes, find teams and partners. Building in public is faster and fairer.
about.manifesto3: The platform is open to everyone: a developer from Tashkent or Nukus, a student with their first bot, a team raising a round. The more of us there are, the stronger the ecosystem.

guide.title: How to launch on TechRadar.uz
guide.subtitle: Five steps from submission to the top of the ranking
guide.step1Text: A clear name, a precise one-sentence tagline and a square logo of at least 256×256. A good description answers “what problem do you solve and for whom”.
guide.step2Text: Click “Add product”, fill in the form and pick a category. The submission goes to moderation — we usually respond within 24 hours.
guide.step3Text: We check that the product is real, the description is complete and spam-free. If something's off, you'll see the reason on the product page and can fix it.
guide.step4Text: Share your launch link on social media and in chats. Launch-day votes decide whether you make the “Daily Ranking” on the homepage.
guide.step5Text: A live dialogue with first users is the best source of insight and trust. Makers who reply get more votes.
guide.readyText: Publishing is free. Moderation takes up to 24 hours.

legal.privacy1Text: When you sign in with Google or Telegram we receive your name, email (for Google), username and avatar. When you submit a product — the data you provide in the form. Standard access logs are collected technically.
legal.privacy2Text: Data is needed to run your account, display your maker profile, voting and comments. Email is used for sign-in and — only with your consent — for the digest.
legal.privacy3Text: Your public profile (name, username, products) is visible to all visitors. Email is never shared or sold. Infrastructure: Supabase (database and auth) and Vercel (hosting).
legal.privacy4Text: Data is stored in a protected database with row-level security (RLS). Passwords are never stored in plain text. Access to service keys is restricted.
legal.privacy5Text: You can edit your profile, unsubscribe from the digest, or delete your account by contacting us. Consent can be withdrawn at any time.
legal.terms1Text: TechRadar.uz is a platform for publishing and discussing Uzbekistan's tech products. By using the site you accept these terms.
legal.terms2Text: Sign-in is via Google, Telegram or existing credentials. You are responsible for actions performed under your account.
legal.terms3Text: By publishing a product or a comment you confirm you have the right to post these materials. Spam, abuse, false information and unlawful content are prohibited.
legal.terms4Text: All products pass moderation. Administration may reject or unpublish content stating a reason, and restrict account access in case of violations.
legal.terms5Text: The platform is provided “as is”. We are not responsible for the operation of third-party products listed in the catalog or the actions of their creators.
